Abstract
The marked rank-six monodromy with finite orders five and four and its primitive
maximal
cusp

on

Its members are pairwise nonisomorphic, have algebraic dimension one and
automorphism group C × Z/2, and have no antiholomorphic isomorphisms between them.
Wall’s extended-form classification and Kramer–Stolz’s 2007 homotopy-sphere absorption
theorem supply the smooth classification input. The calculations here give the actual integral
cusp maps, the genus-two exterior-square period construction, the family invariants and
its endpoint obstruction, together with an effective classification of the retained integral
inputs. The hard topological step is the coefficient-one torsion boundary map; the analytic
step is the exact real-transversality minimum. Historical checks are recorded by statement.
GPT-6 Astra Pro re-derived every retained proof in this writing and reran the stated exact
certificates; no human proof reading is recorded in this writing.

Each statement records the actual check scope and preserves the names, effort settings and dates

and date. OpenAI documents reasoning allocation controls (OpenAI, 2026b, sections “Reasoning

control of response-token use, including thinking (Anthropic, 2026, sections “How effort works”
